tasks.label: Build DoorDash
tasks.command: & 'C:\Program Files\Microsoft\jdk-21.0.11.10-hotspot\bin\javac.exe' --module-path 'lib\javafx-sdk-21.0.11\lib' --add-modules javafx.controls,javafx.fxml,javafx.graphics -cp src -d out (Get-ChildItem -Recurse -Filter *.java src | ForEach-Object { $_.FullName }); Copy-Item -Recurse -Force src\game\assets out\game\assets
